prompt: luft-vatten eller bergvärme, vad ska jag välja till min villa

recommendations.title: Create an interactive 'Which pump suits my house' calculator
recommendations.details: Build a web calculator that asks for key inputs (house annual heat demand kWh or floor area and insulation level, current heating type, whether house has waterborne heating, plot size and whether drilling is likely allowed, and desired budget). The tool should estimate annual energy use with SCOP scenarios, give rough installation cost ranges for luft-vatten vs bergvärme, compute simple payback and annual savings at current electricity prices, and give a clear recommendation with next steps (e.g., book hembesök). Include explanations of assumptions and links to municipal/SGU resources.
queryFanouts: "luft-vatten värmepump vs bergvärme villa kostnad effektivitet sverige"
suggestedSections: Intro: what the calculator does and assumptions
Input fields: heat need, existing heating, plot/drill feasibility, budget, location
Results: estimated annual energy use for each option
Costs: installation range, ROT and Villaeffekten impacts
Payback: simple N-year payback and annual savings
Recommendation and next steps: book hembesök, checklist for drilling permissions

recommendations.title: Refresh guide with worked payback and sizing examples
recommendations.details: Expand the existing guide page with 2–3 concrete worked examples (small, medium, large villa). For each, show: annual kWh need, recommended pump size, estimated bore depth (for bergvärme) or unit size (for luft-vatten), installation cost range, expected SCOP used, annual electricity consumption for heating, annual operating cost at sample electricity prices, and payback time versus direct electric heating. Add a short FAQ about maintenance and expected lifetime.
